verdict.rationale: Dynadot documents its own aftermarket, reachable through its API for backorders, auction discovery and bidding, and its llms.txt lists aftermarket services. That gives a path to taken or expiring names. Nothing in the evidence shows premium pricing in search results, a buy-now marketplace for listed names, or a broker service. Missing for 10: premium pricing shown in search, a documented buy-now marketplace or broker service for registered names, hands-on corroboration of the aftermarket flow.

support.subject: As a power user, premium and aftermarket domains are first-class — premium pricing shown in search, and a marketplace or broker path for taken names

citations.quote: Use our API to engage with our aftermarket - place backorder requests, discover new auction listings, place bids, and more.
Dynadot is an ICANN-accredited domain registrar offering domain registration, aftermarket services
